title: Safe Domain Adaptation for Physics: Overcoming Nuisances, Label Shifts, and Simulation Priors
abstract: arXiv:2608.18190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain adaptation is widely used to make neural networks trained on simulations applicable to experimental data. Its premise is that the two domains differ only in nuisances, and that the quantity of interest is distributed identically in both. In physics neither assumption holds: simulations can be wrong about the physics, and the distribution of the target quantity - an energy spectrum, a redshift distribution - is often the measurement itself. We study the consequences of such mismatches on a toy air-shower benchmark in which a detector-response nuisance, a physical simulation shift, and an energy-spectrum shift can be switched on separately or together. Standard adversarial adaptation handles the conditional shifts, but once the two spectra differ it aligns them, replacing an uncontrolled bias by one anchored on the simulation prior. translated_title: 面向物理的安全域自适应：克服干扰、标签偏移与模拟先验
translated_abstract: 域自适应被广泛用于使在模拟数据上训练的神经网络适用于实验数据。其前提是两个域仅在干扰因素上存在差异，且目标量的分布在两者中相同。在物理学中，这两个假设均不成立：模拟可能在物理过程上出错，而目标量（如能谱、红移分布）的分布本身往往就是测量对象。我们研究这些不匹配在一个玩具气簇射基准上的后果，在该基准中，探测器响应干扰、物理模拟偏移和能谱偏移可以单独或同时开启。标准对抗性自适应能够处理条件偏移，但一旦两个能谱不同，它会将其对齐，从而用基于模拟先验的偏差替换无控制偏差。我们提出自适应域自适应，该方法对模拟事件进行重新加权，以聚焦域自适应。
tldr: 本文提出自适应域自适应方法，通过重新加权模拟事件来应对物理模拟偏移与目标分布差异，避免标准对抗方法因对齐能谱而引入基于模拟先验的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes adaptive domain adaptation that reweights simulated events to address physical simulation shifts and target distribution differences, avoiding the bias introduced by standard adversarial methods when aligning spectra.
